description: Read SQL the way Only in the Tab's pre-flight check does and flag what bites: a DELETE or UPDATE with no WHERE, TRUNCATE, an unguarded DROP, a table created in public without row level security, a policy that allows everything, a create that cannot be re-run. A heuristic read, not a parser; it never runs the SQL. At most 50000 characters. Nothing sent is stored.
name: check_sql
title: Check SQL before it runs
